description.en: Pseudobornia ursina interpretation informed by Rastier2025 primary reappraisal, vegetative description p12-13 and Fig3, fertile interpretation Fig15 also inspected. Primary fossils mostly detached; exact complete outline remains uncertain. Two-metre artistic juvenile whole-habit form rather than claim of mature fossil size. Nominal8cm leaves are source-informed illustrative target, not hard tolerance.
